entries.title: cargo test compiles sqlx::query! online against .env's feedbackmonk_dev, which lacks a lane's new migrations
symptoms: error returned from database: column "[a-z_]+" does not exist
error returned from database: relation "[a-z_]+" does not exist
entries.cost: contracts lane of collab-20261013-145347: the independent re-run of a green proof went red and needed a manual offline re-run
entries.fix: Prefix cargo with SQLX_OFFLINE=true so the macros read the committed .sqlx cache; #[sqlx::test] still builds fresh databases from migrations/ via DATABASE_URL. Or apply the new migrations to feedbackmonk_dev first.

entries.title: npx playwright run outside admin-ui (or without --no-install) fetches a different Playwright and finds no tests
symptoms: npm warn exec The following package was not found and will be installed: playwright@
entries.cost: collab-20261013-171541: both UI lanes' independent re-runs went red and needed a manual re-run
entries.fix: Run from admin-ui and pin the local binary: cd admin-ui && CI=1 npx --no-install playwright test <specs> (the same in widget/ and marketing/). CI=1 no longer isolates a worktree: the test queue adopts whatever answers on the lane's port (14204, 14206, 14222), so a worktree run tests the tree whose server holds that port -- stop that server first, or run from the tree that owns it.

entries.title: converge.py checks' landing check selects no new Rust test; the suite green covers only TypeScript
entries.cost: both prioritization wave critics (C-003, C-001) had to run the Rust tests by hand
entries.fix: After converge.py checks, run the wave's Rust targets yourself: SQLX_OFFLINE=true DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:dev@localhost:5433/feedbackmonk_dev cargo test -p <crate> --test <new targets>, and hand the critic the result.
